name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 9 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-01-01, at wavelengths from 0.95 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
